entries.name: Algonquin College — Centre for Accessible Learning (CAL)
entries.description: The Centre for Accessible Learning provides academic accommodations and educational support services for students with permanent or temporary disabilities. Interim accommodations may be provided while a student is being assessed for a disability.
entries.cost_note: Services are confidential, free and voluntary; students must self-identify to access them.
entries.evidence: The CAL provides academic accommodations and educational support services for students who have permanent and/or temporary disabilities.
entries.notes: Appointments are booked through the page's 'Book an Appointment' link.

entries.name: Algonquin College — Peer Tutoring Centre
entries.description: The Peer Tutoring Centre matches current students who are having academic difficulties with trained students for one-to-one tutoring in specific courses. Tutors must have finished the course with at least a B+ and have a professor's recommendation.
entries.cost_note: The tutoring fee is $8.00 per hour (effective May 8, 2018); students with severe financial hardship can apply for financial support.
entries.evidence: The Algonquin Peer Tutoring Centre matches current students who are having academic difficulties with trained students for one-to-one tutoring.
entries.notes: Offered to all Algonquin College students.

entries.name: Algonquin College — Student Support Services Events Calendar
entries.description: A calendar of the weekly events run by Student Support Services, such as Snack Chats, Connect & Create and workshops.
entries.evidence: Events are a great way to meet people and try new things. A variety of events from Student Support Services take place every week.
entries.notes: On 17 Oct 2026 the calendar listed Snack Chats (Oct 13–Dec 8) and Connect & Create (Oct 15–Dec 3), among others.

entries.name: Cambrian College — Accessibility Services (Glenn Crombie Centre)
entries.description: The Glenn Crombie Centre for Accessibility, Counselling and Wellness provides reasonable academic accommodations for students who are disabled or have learning challenges. Students without a documented disability may still qualify for its services.
entries.cost_note: Cost: Free (as listed on the page).
entries.evidence: If you’re disabled or have learning challenges, we provide reasonable academic accommodations based on your needs
entries.notes: Appointments are recommended once you have decided to apply to Cambrian.

entries.name: Cambrian College — Learning Centre
entries.description: The Learning Centre offers tutoring across a broad range of subjects, peer-to-peer tutoring for specific classes, and workshops on topics such as research, time management and study skills. Students can visit on campus or online.
entries.cost_note: The page lists cost as 'Varies by service'.
entries.evidence: the Learning Centre offers tutoring across a broad range of subjects and gives you access to innovative English tutoring resources anytime.

entries.name: Cambrian College — Ready, Get SET, College!
entries.description: A free on-campus program before the fall term that introduces incoming students to Cambrian's services and systems, practises success skills such as time management and test preparation, and offers English, math or health sciences preparation.
entries.cost_note: All sessions are FREE and are open to anyone attending Cambrian College in September.
entries.evidence: Ready, Get SET, College! will introduce you to services and systems at Cambrian College, and provide tips and tricks for college success
entries.notes: Listed for August 23 to September 3, 2027, for Canadian students entering a Cambrian program in September 2027; attendance must be in person. Contact is Academic Upgrading.

entries.name: Canadore College — Accessible Learning Services
entries.description: Accessible Learning Services works with students who have permanent, temporary, episodic or suspected disabilities to identify barriers, develop accommodation plans and connect with supports.
entries.cost_note: Registration and accommodation services are provided at no additional cost to students.
entries.evidence: Accessible Learning Services (ALS) works with students who have permanent, temporary, episodic, or suspected disabilities to identify barriers, develop accommodation plans
entries.notes: The eligibility list on the page names Learning Disabilities, ADHD and Autism Spectrum Disorder. Students can contact a virtual front desk, call, email or drop by Student Success Services.

entries.name: Canadore College — Peer Tutoring
entries.description: Peer Tutoring pairs students who are facing challenges in a specific course with peers who have already mastered the material, to clarify concepts, review course material and build problem-solving strategies.
entries.cost_note: The cost of tutoring is just $20 for every 10 hours of services, paid online once matched with a tutor.
entries.evidence: Peer Tutoring pairs students who are facing challenges in a specific course with peers who have already successfully mastered the material.
entries.notes: Face-to-face sessions are held in designated areas on campus; online sessions use institutional MS Teams links.

entries.name: Canadore College — Start Strong: Accessible Learning Summer Transition Program
entries.description: A transition program from Accessible Learning Services and Student Success Services that helps new students build confidence, connect with support services and learn what to expect before classes start. It includes a self-paced D2L course, a parent and supporter session and a Student Success Open House in the first week of classes.
entries.evidence: Start Strong helps you build confidence, connect with support services, and learn what to expect before your first day of classes.
entries.notes: Registration is open to all newly registered Canadore students.

entries.name: Centennial College — Centre for Accessible Learning and Counselling Services (CALCS)
entries.description: CALCS provides programs and services for students' wellness goals and their accommodation and disability-related needs, and works toward a more accessible campus community.
entries.evidence: provides a range of programs and services aimed to empower students in meeting their wellness goals, accommodation and disability-related needs
entries.notes: Appointments are booked through the page's 'Book an Appointment' link.

entries.name: Centennial College — Peer Tutoring (Learning Centre)
entries.description: Students having trouble with a specific course can get help, one-on-one or in small groups, from senior students recommended by their department. Booking is through the Learning Centre.
entries.cost_note: Anyone that’s enrolled in the College can use this service for free.
entries.evidence: Anyone that’s enrolled in the College can use this service for free. There’s also extra support for students with learning disabilities.

entries.name: Centennial College — Peer Mentorship Program
entries.description: Experienced peers guide students as they transition into college and through their studies, sharing information about campus resources and running social events.

entries.notes: The page says the program is open to all semester students; registration is by an online form.

Transition program: 'Ce programme d’une semaine est offert gratuitement* aux étudiantes et aux étudiants ayant un trouble d’apprentissage ou un trouble déficitaire de l’attention.'

entries.name: Collège Boréal — Réussite scolaire (tutorat et appui à la réussite)

entries.notes: Page in French.

entries.name: Conestoga College — Accessible Learning

entries.evidence: Conestoga provides support and academic accommodation for students with all types of disabilities in keeping with the Ontario Human Rights Code.
entries.notes: The documentation section names ASD and ADHD among the disability types covered. C Success is 'an orientation program designed specifically for students who experience barriers to college participation and who are registered with Accessible Learning.'

entries.notes: Evidence is the 'Services' list on the page. Peer tutoring details and booking are on the Conestoga Success Portal, which needs a college sign-in.

entries.name: Confederation College — Student Accessibility Services
entries.description: Students with a permanent or temporary disability, or who had an Individual Education Plan (IEP) in high school, are encouraged to contact Student Accessibility Services about available supports and accommodations. Intake appointments can be booked online.

entries.name: Confederation College — Tutoring Office (Academic Supports)
entries.description: The Tutoring Office offers one-to-one tutors, group tutoring and online support through Tutor.com, along with a Writing Centre and learning and study skills support.
entries.evidence: One-to-one tutors, group tutoring, and online support through Tutor.com
entries.notes: Page is on Confederation's orientation site.

entries.name: Durham College — Access and Support Centre (ASC)

entries.name: Durham College — Peer Tutoring (Student Academic Learning Services)
entries.description: Peer tutors hired and trained by Student Academic Learning Services help students review and practise course content and offer study tips. Students can book up to 2 hours a week through WC Online.

entries.name: Durham College — Start Strong at DC: ASC Transition Events

entries.notes: Students with physical, mental health or learning challenges that have not been formally identified are also welcome. The page says registration is done for this year and to check back next spring/summer.

entries.name: Fanshawe College — Accessibility Services
entries.description: Accessibility Services helps students with disabilities register, get guidance on documentation and funding, and arrange academic accommodations. Students unsure whether they qualify, or without documentation yet, can still get help.

entries.notes: A separate Transitions Programs page lists Fanshawe Here We Come (a one-day, in-person late-summer event for new students registered with Accessibility Services) and the virtual Here For You pre-orientation series.

entries.name: Fanshawe College — Academic Support and Resources (Peer Tutoring, Library Learning Commons)
entries.description: Fanshawe's academic supports include peer tutoring, which offers one-on-one help for students having difficulty in a specific course, and the Library Learning Commons, whose services are available to students at any campus.

entries.notes: The page also lists academic advisors, apprenticeship learning supports and the Test Centre.

entries.name: Fleming College — Accessible Education Services

It is hosted at the Sutherland (Peterborough) Campus for students of any Fleming campus.
